subject: Adding a geom_sf polygon to legend

messages.author: c621ac38989fbf3c
messages.subject: Adding a geom_sf polygon to legend
parts:
Hi, I've got a geom_sf polygon layer (highlighted) that I would like to appear in the legend. In the map image it is the light blue dotted circle, which is a polygon with just the border.

I can't seem to figure out how to add it to the legend. I'd appreciate any help!


ggmap(map1, extent="panel" ) +
  geom_sf( data=states , fill=NA , color="Black" ,
           cex=2 , inherit.aes = F) +
  geom_sf( data=nr , fill=NA , color="Lightblue" ,
           cex=1 , lty=3 , inherit.aes = F , show.legend=TRUE ) +
  geom_tile( data=pred , aes(Longitude, Latitude , fill= exp( Estimate ) ) ,
             color="NA" , inherit.aes = F) +
  scale_fill_viridis( option="B" , "Prevalence" , trans="log" ,
                      breaks=c(0.0001 , 0.001 , 0.01 ,
                               0.1 , 1 , 10 , 100) ,
                      labels=c("0.0001" , "0.001" , "0.01" ,
                               "0.1" , "1" , "10" , "100")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-82, -79.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(35.4, 37.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Longitude") +
  ylab("Latitude")
